content: MK judges that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn appears to have been closest to Niʿmat Allāh Valī and Qāsim-i Anvār; for Niʿmat Allāh the Munshaʾāt letter tallies with later Niʿmatullahi accounts of his visiting Niʿmat Allāh's khanaqah in Kuhbanan and travelling with him to Akhlāṭī in Cairo.
refers_to_primary: MK's judgement on the Munshaʾāt and Niʿmatullahi sources
